description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TopNavAdapter for displaying top navigation categories in an Android TV application. It supports focus management, visual feedback, and handles special search items.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying top navigation tabs with focus handling and click actions.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

attributes.name: TopNavDiff
attributes.description: DiffUtil callback to optimize list updates.

attributes.name: SEARCH_ITEM
attributes.description: Constant string token representing the search item in the list.

inner_class.name: TopNavVH
inner_class.description: ViewHolder class managing individual navigation item views and their focus/ click features.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a list of items to the adapter, triggering UI update.
